definitions.explanation: A question word used before a noun to ask which specific item. Always followed by a noun.

examples.japanese: どの⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
どの⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}ります→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？

どの⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{田中|たなか}⟦さん→さん：09848_san⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧な⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かりません→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Which person is Mr. Tanaka? I only heard his name, so I don't know his face.
Which color do you like? I like blue, but I think red is nice too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧だった⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、どの⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|い}けば→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}からなくて→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧、⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}きました→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: It was my first time there, so I didn't know which road to take and asked someone at the station.

notes:
どの is a pre-noun adjectival meaning "which," always followed by a noun.

こそあど SERIES:
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧: this ~ (near speaker)
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧: that ~ (near listener)
- ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧: that ~ (far from both)
- どの: which ~ (question)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どの⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: which person
- どの⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧: which book
- どの⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧: which train
- ⟦どのくらい→どのくらい：09584_donokurai⟧/⟦どのぐらい→どのぐらい：noentry⟧: how much, how long

DISTINCTION:
- どの + noun: which ~ (modifies noun)
- ⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧: which one (stands alone as pronoun)

EXAMPLE CONTRAST:
どの⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧？(Which book do you want?)
⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧？(Which one do you want?)
